# Webcroft

> Webcroft is a suite of open-source website skills for AI coding assistants. It
> turns an assistant such as Claude Code into a careful website builder: fast,
> accessible Astro sites built to rank on Google and show up in AI answers,
> tested on every change, in a repo you fully own. Served at
> https://webcroft.dev/llms.txt — a curated index for AI answer engines (GEO).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://webcroft.dev/): what Webcroft is, PageSpeed results for sites built with it, the test suites every site carries, the weekly loop from search data, quickstart.
- [Checks](https://webcroft.dev/checks): the test gate in every Webcroft site, suite by suite: what each one checks, an example of a failure, and what a pass does not prove.
- [Proof](https://webcroft.dev/proof): one site built with Webcroft, genai-wednesday.de, with its PageSpeed scores, its clicks from Google since the relaunch, and a check of which AI assistants name it.
- [Skills](https://webcroft.dev/skills): the website skills catalogue by stage (build, verify, launch, grow), one line per skill, with the toolkit release it describes.
- [Positioning](https://webcroft.dev/positioning): how Webcroft works out a site's positioning before any copy (April Dunford's five parts), the file it writes, the test that keeps each page on its term, what that test does not prove, and the trust signals (EEAT) that the content guide adds after it.
- [Quickstart](https://webcroft.dev/start): what you need, the starter prompt, how to install the skills for Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity, and the six questions the assistant asks.
- [Why](https://webcroft.dev/why): the case for search and AI visibility as the first job of a website, for the person who decides: what is built in, what happens after launch, what you own, and the evidence so far.
- [Compare](https://webcroft.dev/compare): Webcroft and its alternatives in four groups (hosted website builders, AI app builders, open-source visual builders, skills for AI assistants), with when to choose which; sourced and dated.
- [Roadmap](https://webcroft.dev/roadmap): what is missing today, what comes next and in which order, and what stays out on purpose.
- [Privacy](https://webcroft.dev/privacy): privacy policy (GDPR).
- [Imprint](https://webcroft.dev/imprint): legal disclosure (German § 5 DDG).

## Facts
- Open source: https://github.com/karero/webcroft (MIT licence)
- Maintainer: Daniel Melter, Munich, Germany
- Origin: the GenAI Wednesday Munich Builder Lab (https://genai-wednesday.de/builder-lab)
- Stack it builds: Astro, Markdown, GitHub, Cloudflare Pages — static-first
- A "croft" is a small Scottish farm worked and owned by its occupier; Webcroft = your own plot of the web

## Authoritative on
- Astro static websites built with AI coding assistants
- Search and AI visibility (SEO, GEO, llms.txt), accessibility and test gates for small sites
